title: Gaganyaan: What It Takes to Send a Crew

segments.say: Putting a satellite in orbit is hard. Putting people there, and bringing them back alive, is much harder. That is Gaganyaan.
The plan: a crew of three, in orbit about four hundred kilometres up, for up to three days, then a safe splashdown at sea.

anim.title: What must be built
items: A crew module with life support

segments.say: That needs a rocket made safe enough for humans, a capsule that keeps air, heat and pressure right, an escape system, and parachutes to bring it down.

anim.title: The escape system
items: Something goes wrong on the way up
Small motors pull the capsule away

segments.say: The escape system is the crew's lifeline. If the rocket fails on the way up, small motors pull the capsule clear and parachutes bring it down.

items.text: TV-D1: crew escape tested in flight

segments.say: In October twenty twenty-three, the TV-D1 test flight showed that escape system working. In February twenty twenty-four, four Indian Air Force pilots were named as astronaut-designates.
Uncrewed flights come first, with a humanoid robot called Vyommitra on board, before any astronaut flies.

anim.title: For your answer
items: Crew escape system, tested by TV-D1

segments.say: For GS Three: Gaganyaan is India's human spaceflight programme. Remember the safety ladder: human-rated rocket, escape system, uncrewed flights, then crew.

sources: ISRO, Gaganyaan page: demonstrate human spaceflight by launching a crew of 3 to a 400 km orbit for a 3-day mission and returning them safely by landing in Indian sea waters; human-rated LVM3; crew escape system; Vyommitra
ISRO press release, 21 October 2023: Test Vehicle Abort Mission-1 (TV-D1) successfully demonstrated the crew escape system
PIB, 27 February 2024: four astronaut-designates (Indian Air Force test pilots) announced

quiz.q: How many crew does Gaganyaan plan to carry?
quiz.why: A crew of three, for up to three days.

quiz.q: What did the TV-D1 test flight show?
quiz.why: TV-D1 tested the escape system in flight in October 2023.

options: Uncrewed flights, with a humanoid robot
quiz.why: Uncrewed flights carry the robot Vyommitra first.

reviewNote: Facts were read against ISRO's Gaganyaan page, the TV-D1 release and PIB. The four astronaut-designates are not named or shown (living people). The suit photo is of an exhibit. Moving facts: flight dates shift; the script gives none for future flights.
